europe_now.title: Bomb-disposal robot and drone with explosives discovered at Germany's Leipzig airport
europe_now.summary: A bomb-disposal robot and drone carrying explosives were found at Leipzig Airport, prompting heightened security measures across European air travel. The incident raises concerns about coordinated threats targeting critical infrastructure.
